Subject: Renewal QBR + Roadmap workshop — sequencing & recording logistics

Hi Claire / Erin —

Thanks again for the time last week. As we lock the QBR/roadmap workshop for the renewal, wanted to propose a sequencing that keeps the exec overview early but still preserves the technical breakout time your engineering team requested. Draft attached (proposed_schedule_v3.xlsx).

High level: 
- 30m Executive overview (value metrics + renewal ask) — leadership + execs
- 45m Product roadmap deep-dive — PMs + product leads
- 60m Technical workshop (ops & infra breakout) — engineers + platform
- 30m Mutual action plan review + next steps (DocuSign link to follow)

Two ask-items from our side: please confirm (1) whether the exec slot needs to be first (we can flip roadmap/workshop) and (2) whether you want the sessions recorded and shared internally (we typically record product + tech but not execs unless approved).

I've included Marissa (CS lead) and Ben (solutions) on the thread to confirm facilitator assignments. Also attaching the runbook we’ll follow (QBR_runbook_v2.pdf).

If any of these times conflict with your exec calendar we'll propose alternates — looking to lock this by EOD Monday so we can finalize invites.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Laura —

Quick note — the execs have a standing call that morning and prefer the executive overview to be moved to the end of the day (they want to hear the technical implications before committing on budget). Also Erin asked whether we can split the tech workshop into two 30m parallel breakouts (infra + privacy) because our leads overlap.

Recording: we are OK with product and tech recordings but would like exec comments off the record — so we agree with recording only the two breakouts and the roadmap deep-dive.

If you can flip the sequence and show a version with parallel breakouts that would help.

Thanks,
